If you didn't tune into Donald Trump's address to the United Nations General
Assembly in Manhattan, the president played the hits - meaning, it was a
disgusting carnival of self-aggrandizement, flailing bullyboy nonsense, and
mindless bloodlust masquerading as MAGA-fried realpolitik.

He threatened the Cuban delegation, at a time when his government is brutally
[asphyxiating](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/09/17/world/americas/trump-
sanctions-cuba-shipping-containers.html) that nation. As he often does, he
threatened the Iranian people with genocide, **"[
annihilation](https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/tehran-hints-hormuz-
talks-with-us-leaders-gather-un-2026-09-22/),"** and **" hell,"** because he
can't face the fact he's [badly losing a war he
started](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-iran-war-no-way-out). He bragged about his
boat bombing campaign and boasted of his [invasion of
Venezuela](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-venezuela-mexico-invasion-attack-cartels)
and kidnapping of its leader, openly telling all nations, democratic and not,
that the United States is now fully, openly in the business of pillaging,
looting, and extra-legal killing.

**" In January, at my direction, the United States military conducted a
massive military operation penetrating deep into the Venezuelan capital,"**

in history [with Venezuela's leadership] … It was a war … To the victor belong
the spoils, you've all heard that."**
